I spent years looking for a product line I liked enough to stick with and I've found just that with Beauty Without Cruelty. Every product I've tried has performed better than I'd come to expect from a natural skincare product. This moisturizer is one of my favorite BWC products and I have purchased several in a row (something I never did before). My combination/dry skin is flawless w/out a single blemish since I began using this product. It is not heavy, but moisturizes beautifully. It smells gr

reviews.t: VERY Moisturizing... Fantastic Face AND Eye Cream!
reviews.x: I must confess I was a little bit skeptical as to how well a $12 jar of cream would perform on my fickle and sensitive skin in the dry winter months.  Well, let me tell you... I was very pleasantly surprised.  This is a wonderful, organic moisturizer that easily rivals high-end department store creams.  It has a deceptively "light" consistency that is easily absorbed into the skin.  However, once absorbed into the skin... It really outperform itself.  My temperamental skin stayed moistur

I have very dry skin and am over 50 and I have been using this cream for about 10 years.  I really like it because it is a heavy-duty moisturizer, not greasy and the smell is pleasant.  I am very sensitive to odors and was surprised to hear that one user thought it had a heavy odor.  I like this, but it would probably be too much for someone with oily skin.

This product works well for my elderly mother, who has very thin and delicate dry skin. It was recommended that she use the thickest face cream we could find, with a lot of emollients. This is not the thickest, but it is thick enough and works well for her. It has a slightly "natural" smell, it may not have a very long shelf life, we will see as we go. For the price, this was a much better solution for us than the premium products from companies like Dermalogica which were the other opti

I’ve used this face cream for 4 or 5 years now. It’s has a prefect consistency, not too thick and not too thin. Very nice mild smell.  I’ve never broken out or had a reaction with it. I have oily skin. My boyfriend loves it too.  I also support that they don’t test on animals!

After trying several moisturizers, I finally found one that my skin loves!  I always feel like my skin in breathe and it never clogs my pores or feels heavy or greasy.  Would buy this product again. I received my order quickly!
BWC is a super affordable skincare line. I'm a licensed esthetician for 32 years. Also vegan for 42years. I love the products.They work great for me. My stepdaughter 30yrs younger loves them also.

After 30 years of trying everything on the market under $70, I found BWC Maximum Moisture Cream and am sold.  For me, it makes my skin softer and more healthy looking than anything I have tried (like in those nice department stores).  I'm old enough that my laugh lines have turned into deep crevasses (blaming the Texas sun and years of no skin protection, but still love my Texas), but this product has soften even those.  I'm a happy camper.

I liked this stuff but can't say I loved it. It moisterizes but it seems to clog my pores. It's very heavy duty but takes a little rubbing in for it to absorb. Not my favorite. I recommend the BWC alpha hydroxy lotion over this one.
This is wonderful....have used on my psoriasis on my elbow and makes it softer, less dry and less itchy.......I also use it on my face and I highly recommend it.
This moisturizer feels great going on, smells great.  It is at least as good if not better than moisturizers that cost ALOT more.  I love this moisturizer.
I used to use Pond's and this is very much like Ponds (at least to me) and I like the fact that there is no animal testing.

I have used this BWC product for years and loved it. Just right for my older, dry skin. But this last batch, and the one before it, was UNUSABLE! It smells BAD and sits on the skin without being absorbed. Definitely something wrong with it. I stocked up on 6 jars of it -- $90 worth -- for a winter in Mexico and couldn't use any of it. Now that I'm back in the States it is too late to get a refund apparently.

reviews.t: Rich moisture for dry or aging skin
reviews.x: Excellent moisturizer for dry or aging skin. Rich and easily absorbed. I have been using it for over a year now. I live in a dry climate, but my skin is moist and supple. Most importantly, no animal had to suffer for my glowing skin as it is CRUELTY FREE.  I am 51-years-old. Everyone thinks I'm 40 or younger. Maybe it's my genes. Maybe it's this wonderful cream...

I reordered this when I ran out, but for some reason this latest jar smells awful. Kind of chemical or rancid. I can't bring myself to put it only face and will be making my own moisturizer from now on, using the first 4-5 ingredients on the label. Reading the label, you can see it contains synthetic chemicals (which aren't mentioned in the description listing).

Great vegan, cruelty-free product. My skin is very dry and this stuff is excellent. I have reviewed before and will repeat- I don't waste time looking for other products since I found this cream, it goes on my hand, elbows and feet too! Just think what it will do for your chest and face if it works on feet! I highly recommend!

reviews.t: Affordable face cream for sensitive skin!
reviews.x: This is great easy going face cream.  Only thing I was not comfortable is the smell of the cream.  I know it is fragrance free but it could be blended with little bit lavender or orange oil to neutralize the smell of it.

I was really hoping to love this but I apparently had a reaction to it. I broke out with many pimples the very next day after applying it at night. I admit to having sensitive skin but have never seen overnight reaction with ANY product. Bummer... my dry patches did go away that 1 day and my skin looked smooth. But, I can tell the moment I sweat (heat or workout) if a prodict will irritate me because it will burn or itch, and this did allot!

Not sure how this cream is maximum moisture. I have used other BWC products and love them. The Renewal Cream w/CoQ10 and their Aloe toner are two of my favorites. I thought I might try this Maximum Moisture as a night cream but did not find it any more moisturizing than Renewal Cream w/CoQ10. Obviously, it may work well for others. I like the consistency and scent but it did not work for me.

Purchased this to replace my Skinceuticals Emollience cream which costs $60 a jar.  I love this cream!  It has a pleasant smell but it’s not overly scented.  It’s very moisturizing without being greasy...it soaks right into my skin.  It works perfectly for my sensitive skin.  An added bonus is they do not test on animals!!!

I love this face cream.  It's thick but absorbs well.  It's not greasy and doesn't clog pores.  I have dry but sensitive skin and live in the desert so using a good moisturizer is important.  This is hands-down the best I have found.  It smells nice, very light.  And it's vegan and cruelty free.

BWC face creams rock! I love their smoothy texture & absorbency. I have really dry skin and I use the max moisture every day--after rosehip seed oil--it seals in the moisture on my face even more.  Plus, no perfumes, no animal testing, and all natural ingredients.  What could be better?

reviews.t: caused allergic reaction -- not as natural as it appears
reviews.x: The other face cream in the yellow jar by BWC is quite good, but this cream has much more irritating and potentially harmful substances in it (including some retinol) that gave me a red stinging rash on my face. Take a close look at the product's toxicity/ingredients before buying.

reviews.t: cruelty-free face cream that doesn't break me out but still makes me feel pampered and really hydrates my face wonderful
reviews.x: Yay! I finally found a moisturizing, cruelty-free face cream that doesn't break me out but still makes me feel pampered and really hydrates my face wonderfully. Beauty Without Cruelty is a fabulous company with an amazing mission to save animals. Thank you BWC! :)

claims.text: Many reviewers praise it as a rich, effective moisturizer for dry or aging skin, often comparing it favorably to pricier creams.
Several reviewers value that it is cruelty-free and not tested on animals.
A few reviewers note the scent, with some finding it pleasant or mild and others describing a natural smell.
Some reviewers report it clogging pores or being heavy and slow to absorb.
A couple of reviewers raise concerns about unlisted ingredients or a bad-smelling, unusable batch.
